verdicts.explanation: The abstract and Section 2.3 give 1.91 mS/cm at 25℃ for Mg0.25 NZSP, and the 0.200 eV activation energy is stated for the 1200/1100℃-12h protocol. The 1100℃ value is the stated hold temperature of that two-step protocol, and relative density is correctly null.

Section 2.3 gives 0.62 mS/cm at 25℃ for the undoped Mg0 NZSP sample, and Section 2.2 gives 96.4% relative density for Mg0 at 1200/1100℃-12h. No activation energy is stated for Mg0 in the text, so null is correct, and the dopant list is correctly empty.
